quotes.text: Freedom is not a door you find. It is a wall you decide to stop obeying.
We do not mourn the ones who fell. We walk the way they fell, and keep walking.
The world is round, and the enemy is on every side of the circle. That is not a fact. That is a dare.
Every wall we ever trusted was built by someone who wanted us to forget what was outside it.
A hero is just a person who stopped negotiating with the thing that wants to eat him.
You can forgive the blade. You cannot forgive the hand that held it steady.
History is written by the ones who survived the second reading of the news.
They asked what I was willing to lose. I said everything, and I meant it.
The ground does not care about your plans. That is the first lesson. The second is to jump anyway.
Hope is the most expensive thing a small person can carry. Carry it.
We are not the last of anything. We are just the ones who refused to be the last.
A titan falls once. The question is what gets up.
The earth is not beneath you. You are beneath it. Act accordingly.
Balance is not standing still. It is falling, politely.
The fire wants to be free. The water wants to be free. You are just the one holding the cup.
When the storm asks you a question, do not answer with your fists. Answer with your feet.
The moon has been patient longer than any of us. Borrow some of it.
The river does not apologize for the rocks. It simply goes around, and around, and around.
You can bend the metal. You cannot bend the fact that you are tired. Rest, then bend.
The wind is the only teacher that never repeats itself, and it still gets everything through.
A storm is just the sky changing its mind. So are you.
The mountain does not move because it is strong. It moves when it is ready.
I told you the universe is a joke. The universe told you to laugh. That's the whole problem.
We are all just atoms pretending to be a plan. Give it a break.
The multiverse is not a place. It is a habit I never broke.
You want a sign? There's a sign. It says 'no sign.' You're welcome.
Every choice you make, a version of you is already regretting it. Efficiency.
The portal is always open. So is the door. So is the fridge. That's the tragedy.
I have seen the end of the universe. It had a waiting room.
Do not trust the version of you that is smiling. He's lying.
We came from the stars. We are going back to the stars. The stars do not know that either.
The future is just the past with better lighting and worse decisions.
The desert does not forgive. It simply remembers.
The water you carry is the water you are. Spend it like it.
Fear is the mind-killer. So is the water. So is the silence after.
The sand has been here longer than your name. It will be here longer than your grave.
He who touches the sand must be ready to be touched back.
The spice remembers what the body forgets. Let it.
A thousand years from now, this choice will be a whisper. Make it loud enough.
The sun here does not rise. It arrives.
The worm is not your enemy. It is the desert's opinion of you.
The rain here does not wash anything. It just makes the neon honest.
I have seen a face I do not own. It was smiling in a window.
Every memory in this city is for sale. Some are on clearance.
The city dreams in electric blue and wakes up owed money.
You are not the one who remembers. You are the one who was remembered. There is a difference.
The neon does not lie. It just blinks, and the blink is the lie.
Somewhere a blade runner is watching the rain and calling it a hobby.
The future is a used car. The engine runs, but the mileage is a secret.
In this city, the dead have better lighting than the living.
